# RepoLingo v0.1.0

RepoLingo's first public preview makes English GitHub content easier to read in Simplified Chinese without taking the source text out of reach.

Local translation is the default. RepoLingo uses the Translator API built into compatible Chrome and Edge releases, so no RepoLingo account, API key, bundled model, or cloud service is required. OpenAI, Gemini, and DeepSeek remain explicit, optional enhancements for users who want a higher-quality provider translation.

## Highlights

- Translate natural-language content in READMEs, repository descriptions, Issues, Pull Requests, Discussions, and Releases.
- Switch instantly between original, translated, and bilingual views without reloading the page.
- Preserve code, commands, URLs, file paths, versions, commit SHAs, flags, placeholders, and identifiers.
- Fall back to the English source when placeholder validation or quality checks fail.
- Keep translations in page memory instead of building a persistent browsing-history cache.
- Run with vanilla TypeScript, HTML, and CSS and no telemetry or runtime UI framework.

## Install

RepoLingo is not available in the Chrome Web Store or Edge Add-ons yet.

1. Download `repolingo-chromium-v0.1.0.zip` and the accompanying `.sha256` file below.
2. Verify the archive if desired, then extract it.
3. Open `chrome://extensions` or `edge://extensions`.
4. Enable **Developer mode**.
5. Select **Load unpacked** and choose the extracted directory.
6. Open a GitHub repository and use the `中文 ⇄ EN` control in the upper-right corner.

The browser may download a shared language pack the first time translation is requested. Once prepared, local translation can continue offline.

## Verification

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\repolingo-chromium-v0.1.0.zip -Algorithm SHA256
```

Compare the result with `repolingo-chromium-v0.1.0.sha256` attached to this release.

## Quality and package size

- 22 automated tests.
- 120 reviewed reference cases across five GitHub page types.
- Manifest, security-boundary, secret, and build-entry checks.
- 28.6 KB release archive and approximately 62 KB unpacked.
- Hard release budgets of 250 KB zipped and 500 KB unpacked.

## Known limitations

- Officially supports desktop Chrome 138+ and Edge versions that expose the Translator API.
- v0.1 officially supports English to Simplified Chinese only.
- Firefox and mobile browsers are not supported.
- Installation currently requires Developer mode.
- Machine translation cannot guarantee zero semantic errors; the English source always remains one click away.

See the [README](https://github.com/agilawiegel-ux/repolingo-extension#readme), [privacy policy](https://github.com/agilawiegel-ux/repolingo-extension/blob/main/PRIVACY.md), [security policy](https://github.com/agilawiegel-ux/repolingo-extension/blob/main/SECURITY.md), and [roadmap](https://github.com/agilawiegel-ux/repolingo-extension/blob/main/ROADMAP.md) for complete details.
